meta.title: Ball dropped in front of a paper sheet
meta.question: What is the acceleration of the falling ball in m/s^2?
meta.notes: Field clip B03 from Set B (gravity). The back of a head at the top-right edge is blurred.

spec.notes: Ball drops rapidly past the paper with brief motion blur during free fall.

result.method: centroid; average acceleration along vertical; local quadratic window 0.30 s on detected frames only; scale from size/extent (longest); bootstrap B=500

checks.name: physical_bounds
checks.threshold: spec range [0, 20] and hard limits [0, 50] SI

result.abstain_reason: The scale changes across the picture (perspective), so one ruler doesn't fit.

instances.target: instance 0 of 1: longest continuous track, ties by mean confidence then mean area
instances.reference: instance 0 of 1: longest continuous track, ties by mean confidence then mean area

guess.text: The falling ball accelerates at about 9.8 m/s^2.
